name: TikTok
note: TikTok's Help Center has no keyboard-shortcuts article: https://support.tiktok.com/en/using-tiktok/exploring-videos/keyboard-shortcuts (the path named in the task) 404s, the 'Exploring videos' category page has no such entry, and the Help Center's own search returns zero results for "keyboard" or "keyboard shortcuts"; the player also has no on-screen shortcut overlay or '?' help dialog. Per the task's fallback for players with no help article, these were instead confirmed by directly testing the web player at tiktok.com/foryou: Space toggled play/pause, Up/Down navigated to the previous/next video in the feed, Left/Right stepped the seek position backward/forward, L triggered the like action (opened the login prompt when logged out, confirming the binding), and M toggled the mute icon. F (fullscreen) and Enter had no observable effect and are not included. No help article states exact seek/step increments, so none are claimed here.
